test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, how was the scenario different twenty years ago?

options.text: Decisions were simpler as there were not many choices.
Everyone looked forward to outings enthusiastically.
There was no bonding between family members.
Decisions were taken by the head of the family and everybody agreed.

solution:
The correct option is **Decisions were taken by the head of the family and everybody agreed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the 4th line, it is said **"Twenty years ago, you would step out of home, the decision of meal and venue already made with no arguments or opposition and everybody looked forward to the meal with equal enthusiasm. The decision was made by the head of the family and the others fell in line". **

**​**Thus, **Option 4 **is the most appropriate option for the given question. 

97
